steps.title: Stack behind the tank for the LB3
steps.rule: A tank LB3 check: the hit kills anyone the LB3 doesn't cover. Everyone stacks just south of Pandora right behind the MT, and the tank on LB3 presses it about halfway through the cast so it's still up when the cast ends.

MainTank.rule: Hold Pandora at the centre from 4m south, with the party stacked right behind you.
